# authwise_clients (Data Source)

An OAuth 2.0 client of an issuer: an application that signs people in or calls an API. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `clients` (Attributes List) Every client under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clients))

<a id="nestedatt--clients"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clients`

Read-Only:

- `appearance_profile_id` (String)
- `application_url` (String)
- `audience_id` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `grant_type` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `login_url` (String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `post_logout_redirect_uris` (List of String)
